scripts.lint: biome ci . && markdownlint-cli2 && zizmor --offline . && zigordev check && pnpm run lint:infra
scripts.lint:infra: tofu fmt -check -recursive infra && tflint --chdir=infra/backups && tflint --chdir=infra/bootstrap && tflint --chdir=infra/github && tflint --chdir=infra/host && tflint --chdir=infra/cloudflare && tflint --chdir=infra/email && tflint --chdir=infra/deploy && tflint --chdir=infra/grafana-cloud && tflint --chdir=infra/grafana
scripts.test:infra: mkdir -p "${TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR:=$HOME/.cache/opentofu/plugins}" && export TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR && tofu -chdir=infra/backups init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/backups test && tofu -chdir=infra/bootstrap init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/bootstrap test && tofu -chdir=infra/github init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/github test && tofu -chdir=infra/host init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/host test && tofu -chdir=infra/cloudflare init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/cloudflare test && tofu -chdir=infra/email init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/email test && tofu -chdir=infra/deploy init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/deploy test && tofu -chdir=infra/grafana-cloud init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/grafana-cloud test && tofu -chdir=infra/grafana init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly > /dev/null && tofu -chdir=infra/grafana test
scripts.check:quick: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && vitest run && pnpm run test:infra
scripts.check: start=$(date +%s); pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test; code=$?; echo "check took $(( $(date +%s) - start )) s"; exit $code
